Student Attendance — personal attendance manager for one teacher
Version 1.0

Each account is isolated. Your departments, lectures, students, and attendance stay on this device in SQLite. Email/password uses hashed credentials. Google Sign-In uses Credential Manager and a verified Google ID token. This app is free and does not use paid SMS, subscriptions, or paid cloud services.
Import an Excel sheet of departments, classes, courses, and students, or export the current roster.
Choose which class the imported students belong to.

Required columns: Department Name, Shift, Semester, Section, Course/Subject Name, Course Code, Student Name, and Roll No. Roll numbers stay text, including leading zeros. Existing classes are reused and attendance is kept.
